name: Cleaved
source:
Cleaved follows the story of a prestigious scientist who finds themselves torn from their reality amidst the meltdown of their work. 

Such an unforeseen incident splits existence itself and the residual damage should obliterated any life caught within the blast. Yet, the scientist survives against all odds, and awakens in lands unknown, their minds barren and confused. 

Throughout this story, take the identity of this scientist to recover the pieces of your lost memories, and find yourself thrusted deep into a society never thought to be real by scientific standards. Build friendships, uncover secrets, explore the land, all to one day finally return home to the world you were ripped from.

[From [url=https://funky-dog-studios.itch.io/cleaved]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Cleaved》講述一位著名科學家的故事。在研究專案失控崩潰之際，這位科學家突然被迫脫離原本的現實。

這場意料之外的事故劈開了存在本身，殘餘衝擊本應抹殺爆炸範圍內的一切生命。然而，科學家卻奇蹟般倖存下來，在未知的土地上醒來，腦海空白，迷惘不已。

在故事中，你將以這位科學家的身分，找回失落記憶的碎片，並深入一個按科學常理本不該存在的社會。建立友誼，揭露秘密，探索這片土地，只為有朝一日，終於能回到那個被迫離開的世界，回到家。

[摘自[url=https://funky-dog-studios.itch.io/cleaved]itch.io[/url]]
